subject.title: macOS launchd: plugin/config maintenance can leave Control UI in broken partial-reload state; restart may require doctor --fix

question: What shared degraded-state contract should Gateway expose during plugin/config reload and restart deferral, and should `sessions.resolve` plus Control UI use it instead of ordinary `No session found`?
rationale: The remaining work spans Gateway readiness semantics, session RPC error contracts, Control UI UX, and launchd recovery behavior, with multiple plausible boundaries and an open narrower PR already in review.

options.title: Define Shared Reload State
options.body: Create one Gateway readiness/reload state consumed by session RPCs and Control UI, and validate it under macOS launchd.

options.title: Land Narrow WebChat Notice First
options.body: Treat #95154 as a subset fix for blank WebChat recovery while keeping this issue open for readiness and launchd behavior.

options.title: Fold Into Graceful-Restart Umbrella
options.body: Move the remaining readiness and recovery policy into #57425 if maintainers want one broad restart program.

recommendation.title: Define Shared Reload State
recommendation.body: Create one Gateway readiness/reload state consumed by session RPCs and Control UI, and validate it under macOS launchd.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest identified owner for adjacent Gateway restart-drain work and the broad graceful-restart thread.
